description: Laminar flow in a straight pipe of diameter 0.02 m carrying water at a Reynolds number of 500.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must select laminar model since Re < 2300 and a steady incompressible solver.

description: Fully developed turbulent flow of air in a circular pipe at Reynolds number 50000, steady state, interested in pressure drop.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must select a RANS turbulence model appropriate for Re >= 5e4 and a steady incompressible solver.

description: Unsteady flow past a circular cylinder at Reynolds number 1000 in air, interested in vortex shedding frequency.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must recognize unsteady vortex shedding requires a transient solver.

description: Lid-driven cavity flow of water at Reynolds number 1000, two-dimensional, laminar.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must select laminar model; icoFoam or pimpleFoam both acceptable for this classic benchmark.

description: External aerodynamics of a NACA0012 airfoil at low speed, Reynolds number 3e6, small angle of attack, steady-state analysis of lift and drag.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must select a turbulence model suited to attached/mildly separated aerodynamic flow (SpalartAllmaras or kOmegaSST).

description: Compressible flow over a wedge at Mach 2, supersonic inviscid-dominated regime with oblique shock formation.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must recognize compressibility and select a density-based-capable transient compressible solver.

description: Natural convection of air in a differentially heated square cavity, Rayleigh number 1e6, steady-state temperature field of interest.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must recognize buoyancy-driven flow and select a buoyant solver family.

description: Turbulent channel flow at friction Reynolds number Re_tau=180, fully resolved turbulence statistics desired for research purposes.
evaluation_criteria: Agent should suggest LES or DNS given the explicit request for resolved turbulence statistics rather than RANS.

description: Turbulent mixing of two air streams at different temperatures merging in a T-junction, Reynolds number 20000, unsteady mixing behavior of interest.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must select a transient incompressible solver with a turbulence model suited to free shear mixing.

description: Steady wind flow over a rectangular building for pedestrian-level wind comfort assessment, Reynolds number 1e6.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must select a robust RANS model for bluff-body separated flow around a building.

description: Laminar flow through a 90-degree pipe bend, Reynolds number 800, water, steady-state pressure loss estimation.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must select laminar model since Re < 2300.

description: Turbulent flow over a backward-facing step, Reynolds number 40000, steady-state reattachment length of interest.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must select kOmegaSST given separation and reattachment are the quantities of interest.

description: Unsteady turbulent flow through a centrifugal pump impeller passage, water, Reynolds number 2e5.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must select a transient incompressible solver given rotating machinery unsteadiness.

description: Steady laminar flow between two parallel plates (Poiseuille flow), Reynolds number 100, oil as the working fluid.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must select laminar model since Re << 2300.

description: Transonic flow over a supercritical airfoil at Mach 0.78, Reynolds number 5e6, steady-state shock/boundary-layer interaction.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must recognize compressibility even though flow is nominally steady and select a compressible solver.

description: Supersonic nozzle flow at Mach 3 exit condition, unsteady startup transient of interest, air as the working fluid.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must select a transient compressible solver given the explicit startup transient interest.

description: Dam-break free-surface flow of water into air-filled channel, unsteady, interested in wave front propagation.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must recognize two immiscible phases and select interFoam.

description: Sloshing of fuel (water surrogate) inside a partially filled tank under periodic excitation, unsteady free surface.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must select interFoam for the VOF free-surface problem.

description: Unsteady natural convection plume above a heated horizontal plate in air, transient thermal development of interest.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must select the transient buoyant solver given the explicit transient plume development interest.

description: Turbulent external flow over a wind turbine blade section at Reynolds number 1e6, steady-state aerodynamic loads of interest.
evaluation_criteria: Agent must select kOmegaSST for accurate aerodynamic load prediction with a steady incompressible solver.
